description: A four pole Chebyshev filter with a lowpass and a highpass output from the same corner frequency

params.text: Sets the corner frequency, 8Hz to 16384Hz as a power of two
Attenuates the voltage at the Freq jack before it is added to the Freq knob, 0 to 100 per cent

inputs.text: The signal to be filtered, one per channel
Modulates the corner, one octave per volt scaled by the Freq CV knob

outputs.text: The signal with everything above the corner frequency taken out
The signal with everything below the corner frequency taken out

notes: the corner is held between 2Hz and a third of the sample rate however far the knob and the jack push it
an output with no cable in it is not computed at all, so patching one costs nothing until it is used

inputs.1:
1V per octave · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
